title: Visual get all stage 3 star
features:
Get all stage for flex ofc
You can spawn a normal enemy In tumore [most likely use to spawn chapter 5]
Don't click play/sandbox on stage that you haven't unlocked
Can't spawn tumore enemy version
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Stage = Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerData.Unlocked.Stage

for _, Chapter in ipairs(Stage:GetChildren()) do
    if Chapter:IsA("Folder") then
        for _, Difficulty in ipairs(Chapter:GetChildren()) do
            if Difficulty:IsA("Folder") then
                for _, Star in ipairs(Difficulty:GetChildren()) do
                    if Star:IsA("NumberValue") or Star:IsA("IntValue") then
                        Star.Value = 30
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
